column1: # L2 screening log (search protocol S1 + S2 of research/checks/l2_hardness.py, registration ade0542), run once by EVO-43 on 2026-10-13 (UTC 23:13 query time).
# S2: Europe PMC REST (resultType=core, pageSize=200, default relevance order) and OpenAlex (/works?search=, per-page=200, relevance) for Q-b1..Q-a2 as registered;

#   raw responses in the gitignored sources/raw/l2-2026-10-13/search/ (sha256 in research/checks/results/raw/l2_quotes.md and l2_inputs.json). 1651 hits, 1478 after DOI/title de-duplication. No snowballing.
# Stages: T = title screen (exclusion reason coded 'T: off-topic' = not a human demographic estimate of selection components or of population regulation); A = abstract screen; F = full text.
# Operational rules fixed at run time, before extraction (they are not in the registration; reviewers should treat them as run-time choices):
#  R-E2: pre_transition = true if (i) the source dates the cohort before its population's fertility decline or reports natural fertility (no conscious birth control), or
#        (ii) the source reports mean live births per woman >= 6 (completed families where given) and reports no contraception or induced abortion for that group.
#        Otherwise false ('unclear' counts as false). Pre-reproductive mortality is deliberately NOT used to judge E2 (it is the numerator of h).
#  R-relay: values a source quotes from other studies are not admitted (AGENTS rule 2: the original was not checked); only the source's own estimates.
#  R-abstract: numbers printed in a fetched abstract (EPMC raw abstractText; OpenAlex inverted index rebuilt in order) satisfy E4/E5 when both components are printed.
#  R-E2false-entry: records failing only E2 are entered with pre_transition=false (they feed the registered 'modern included' line) when population-level components are printed.
#  R-derived: Ps = 1/(1+Im) when Ps is not printed; If = (I - Im) x Ps when only I and Im are printed (identities printed in each source).

# Disclosure: screening read abstracts, and some abstracts print Crow components, so some values were seen before the R-E2 rule was written down; the rule is mechanical and was applied to all records alike.
